name: Unlocking a locked vault: wrong passphrase, then the right one

steps.text: The folder pair 'Private' shows 'Vault locked' and an 'Unlock vault' button
Type 'wrong passphrase' into the passphrase field and confirm
An error says the passphrase is wrong and the vault stays locked
Clear the passphrase field, type 'correct horse battery' and confirm
The 'Private' card no longer shows 'Vault locked' or the 'Unlock vault' button
